crossRefs.note: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.
But as for me, behold, I am in your hand. Do with me what is good and right in your eyes.
Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into…
He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered…

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

translations.web: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”
translations.bsb: “Keep your money,” said the king to Haman. “These people are given to you to do with them as you please.”
translations.kjv: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good
translations.asv: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.
